head: Losing It: a $0.99 weight loss journal that shows each pound as a bubble
dek: Losing It, an iPhone and iPad app out since 14 November, logs weigh-ins and shows your progress as one bubble per pound, with an optional food log, progress photos and widgets; it has no account or ads. On 25 November it was #90 among paid Health & Fitness apps on the US App Store.
